name: MEO Kalorama 26
description:
Parque da Bela Vista, in Lisbon, will once again host MEO Kalorama, which reaches its 5th edition in 2026.

Since 2022, the festival has been establishing itself as the biggest summer festival in the city of Lisbon, taking over one of the capital’s most beautiful parks each year for a celebration that brings together Music, Art, and Sustainability.

This year MEO Kalorama is taking place on the last weekend of August — the 28th, 29th, and 30th — once again marking the end of summer and the return to routine for all music lovers.

name: Tomorrowland 26 Belgium
description: Tomorrowland is one of the largest and most iconic electronic music festivals in the world, taking place every year in July in Boom, Belgium. The first edition of Tomorrowland was held in 2005 as a one-day festival with 9.000 visitors. Today, Tomorrowland stretches over two weekends, welcoming 400.000 People of Tomorrow from all over the world. Tomorrowland caters to all genres in electronic dance music with hundreds of renowned artists performing across more than 15 different stages.

name: Sziget 26
description:
Sziget Festival 2026 is returning to Budapest from August 11–15, 2026, transforming the city’s Óbuda Island into the ultimate playground for music lovers, free spirits, and festival adventurers.

Sziget Festival started way back in 1993 as a small gathering, unlike the Budapest music festival you know today. Fast forward to 2026, and it’s one of Europe’s biggest and best music festivals, featuring over 1,000 shows across 60 stages over 5 incredible days.
